problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{12}$ in the matrix
$X=[\begin{aligned}6a & -3a & c \\ -b & {b}^{2} & -2c \\ -a & 0 & b\end{aligned}]?$
worked_solution:
First, we remove the first row and second column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -3a & ∗ \\ -b & ∗ & -2c \\ -a & ∗ & b\end{aligned}]
$$

Next, we calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det[\begin{aligned}-b & -2c \\ -a & b\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}-b & -2c \\ -a & b\end{aligned}| \\  & =-b\cdot b-(-2c)\cdot (-a) \\  & =-{b}^{2}-2ac\end{aligned}
$$
